privacy.notice: Your file is never uploaded. It stays in this browser.

network.none: No data has left this browser.
network.foreign: 1 request went to another site. | {n} requests went to other sites.
network.explain: Every request this page has made since it opened. Your file is read, checked and cleaned here, and never sent anywhere.
network.allOwn: All requests went to this site ({host}): the app's own code, fonts and text, and the name model if you downloaded it.
network.toAi: 1 request went to the AI you chose. | {n} requests went to the AI you chose.
network.aiOnly: Requests to the AI you chose are listed with the bytes sent. Everything else stayed on this site.

nameModel.heading: Names and places
nameModel.explain: Names and places need a name model: {size}, downloaded once from this site and kept in this browser. Your file is not sent anywhere.
nameModel.costly: This is a large download. Consider Wi-Fi.
nameModel.progress: Downloading the name model: {loaded} of {total} MB
nameModel.background: You can start the review now. The download goes on in the background.
nameModel.stored: Name model stored in this browser ({size}).
nameModel.notStored: This browser had no room to keep the name model. It works for this visit and downloads again next time.
nameModel.failed: The download stopped at {loaded} of {total} MB. Check the connection and try again.
nameModel.withoutIt: Everything else is checked without it.
nameModel.offline: You're offline. The name model can be downloaded once you're back online; everything else works now.

announce.removed: Name model removed from this browser.

nameModel.smallScreen: Names are checked on a larger screen. Everything else works here.

nameScan.skipped: Names were checked in {done} of {total} rows, then skipped. Names in the other rows won't be removed from the download.
nameScan.skippedNone: Names were skipped for this file. They won't be removed from the download.
nameScan.failed: Checking for names stopped. The other findings are not affected.
nameScan.downloadWaits: The download is available when names are checked.

confirm.title: Skip names for this file?
confirm.body: Names won't be removed from the download.

importNotes.document: Documents and transcripts are on the roadmap. For now, Painfold reads CSV and Excel files.

smallScreen.title: Painfold likes a bigger screen
smallScreen.body: This phone shows it off nicely, but reviewing hundreds of rows is a job for a laptop. Your thumbs will thank you. Open it on your computer: your file stays just as private there.

warning.heading: Could identify someone
warning.title: Could identify someone, row {n}

why.age: An exact age can point to one person, together with other details.
why.role-place: Together with {place}, this job title can point to one person.
why.unique-role-place: One person holds this role in {place}.

warning.placeRemoved: {place} will be removed, so this is less identifying now.
warning.open: It stays in the file unless you remove it. Removing it replaces it with {placeholder}.
warning.removed: Removed. The cleaned file has {placeholder} here.
warning.toCheck: 1 warning to check | {n} warnings to check
warning.removeAllLabel: Remove the warning that is not checked yet | Remove all {n} warnings that are not checked yet

start.privacy: Your file is never uploaded. It stays in this browser.
start.dropOverlay: Drop to open. Nothing is uploaded.
start.privacyAi: Only the cleaned text you approve is sent to the AI you choose.

review.limits: Automatic detection can miss personal data. Review the results before sharing the cleaned file. Painfold helps with data protection but is not legal advice and does not by itself make your processing GDPR compliant.

columns.masked: Values hidden because this column is dropped
columns.help: Check: searched for personal data. Keep as is: copied to the cleaned file without checking. Drop: left out of the cleaned file.

names.checked: Names and places were checked with the name model.
names.partly: Names were checked in {done} of {total} rows; the check was skipped for the rest, so names there were not removed.
names.skipped: Names were not checked: the check was skipped for this file.
names.failed: Names were not checked: the name model could not run.
names.notChecked: Names and places were not checked: the name model was not downloaded.
names.smallScreen: Names were not checked: that happens on a larger screen.

download.mapStays: The list of original values behind each placeholder stays in this browser and is gone when you close the tab.
download.reportExplain: The cleaned file holds only your data. The cleaning report lists what was replaced, with the date, the Painfold version and the limits of automatic detection.
download.notReviewed: Includes 1 finding that was not reviewed. | Includes {n} findings that were not reviewed.

importErrors.unsupported-format: That file type isn't supported. Painfold reads CSV, TSV and Excel (.xlsx) files.

aiPrivacy.keyNote: Your key is sent only to Anthropic, straight from this browser. Painfold has no server and never sees it.
aiPrivacy.rememberNote: Stored in this browser only, until you untick this. Otherwise it is forgotten when you close the tab or start over.
aiPrivacy.localNote: Nothing leaves this computer: Ollama runs the model here.
aiPrivacy.testNote: The test sends only the word “Hello”, never your feedback.

consent.heading: What will be sent
consent.count: 1 cleaned text from {file} | {n} cleaned texts from {file}

toValue.anthropic: Anthropic, {model}, straight from this browser to api.anthropic.com

termsValue.anthropic: Anthropic keeps requests for up to 30 days and does not use them for training (its terms, checked on 13 November 2026).

consent.notSentValue: Your file, the personal data you removed, the column names, short values such as a channel or a plan, and the columns you kept as they are.
consent.costFree: About {tokens} tokens, at no cost: the model runs on this computer.
consent.names: Names were not checked, so these texts may still contain names.
consent.namesConfirm: I have checked these texts for names, or they contain none.
consent.leak: Something you removed in the review would be sent. Nothing can be sent until this is fixed.
consent.instructions: Painfold’s instructions to the AI, sent with every request
consent.download: Download exactly what will be sent (.json)
consent.noReview: Open a file and review it first: only cleaned text can be sent.
consent.nothing: There is no text to analyze in the checked columns.
